summary: Frontend-only testing of the shared header layout fix across BrightCasa static site. Verified desktop (1280px), intermediate (700px), mobile (375px, 320px), and enlarged-text (root font-size 20px) scenarios on index.html and privacy.html. All acceptance criteria met: desktop shows logo + 4 nav links on one horizontal row (links y=23.4, logo centered in 68px row, hamburger hidden); mobile shows logo on left and hamburger at far right on same row (vertically centered), 44x44 CSS-px touch target, aria-label='Toggle navigation menu', checkbox state toggles correctly, dropdown .nav-links shows/hides on click, logo scales down (38px at 320px vs 52px desktop via clamp), no overlap, no horizontal overflow at 320px or under simulated enlarged text.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation looks solid: .site-nav uses flex with align-items:center and width:100%; .nav-toggle-label uses margin-left:auto on mobile to push to far right; nav-logo uses clamp(38px,11vw,52px) for proportional scaling; mobile toggle is visually hidden but still focusable (width/height 1px, opacity 0) preserving a11y.
Minor nit (not a bug): on mobile the hidden input#nav-toggle has pointer-events:none which is correct since the label is the clickable target.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served by express on port 3000 from /app root; use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL preview URL. No data-testid; select by CSS classes. Header fix verified across index.html and privacy.html. Mobile breakpoint is max-width:639px.
